description: A small, glowing sphere that hovers at waist height and emits a gentle hum. It changes color based on nearby sounds.
A flat, translucent disc the size of a dinner plate. When touched, it displays a map of the surrounding area that updates in real time.
A twisted, metallic rod that is warm to the touch. It can be stretched to any length but always springs back to its original shape when released.
A cube made of shifting sand that never falls apart. Pressing one face causes the opposite face to display text from nearby written materials.
A liquid that forms into a solid handle when gripped, but flows like water when released. It is slightly magnetic and tastes faintly of mint.
